name: codeyoung-trial-booking
description: Production-quality trial-class appointment booking system with timezone awareness and load-balanced mentor allocation

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install && cd .. && npm run setup:env
scripts.setup:env: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('server/.env') && fs.existsSync('.env.example')) { fs.copyFileSync('.env.example', 'server/.env'); console.log('[Setup] Created server/.env from .env.example'); }"
scripts.seed: cd server && npm run prisma:push && npm run prisma:seed
